items.q: Single-pass or double-pass RO?
items.a: Single-pass RO and EDI suits moderate solids. Double pass adds margin on conductivity, TOC and silica, for high-solids feed, or for PW feeding a WFI still you run.

items.q: How do you handle cold winter feed?
items.a: Rated at 25 °C, RO can lose a third or more of its output at 5 °C. We size at your coldest feed, or add a heat exchanger.

items.q: Our supply is chloraminated. What changes?
items.a: Chloramine damages RO membranes, so it is removed first, which releases ammonia. Ammonia can pass RO when pH is raised for CO₂ control, so we design both together.

items.q: How is the PP skid sanitized?
items.a: [sanitization method for the PP skid, and its maximum temperature, °C]. Hot water leaves no residual to test for; chemical sanitization adds a residual test.

items.q: How do we know it will pass IQ/OQ?
items.a: Your quality unit approves the FAT protocol and witnesses a wet FAT, in person or remotely, before the skid ships. SAT and OQ then prove performance on your feed.
